class.name: FmodServer
class.brief_description: Global singleton that manages the FMOD audio system lifecycle.
class.description: Initializes the main [FmodSystem], applies the project's [code]audio/fmod[/code] settings, and updates FMOD once per [SceneTree] process frame. Access the singleton through its static methods. [method get_audio_bus_layout] returns bus configuration; [method get_audio_bus_by_id] and [method get_bus_effect_instance] return the corresponding runtime objects. Each effect slot has an independent runtime instance. Changes to the active configuration are applied on the next update, or immediately with [method flush_bus_updates]. With [code]audio/fmod/sync_godot_audio_buses[/code] enabled, Godot's [AudioServer] supplies the configuration. When disabled, the server loads [code]audio/fmod/default_bus_layout[/code], whose default is [code]res://default_fmod_bus_layout.tres[/code]. Changing the synchronization setting requires reloading the project. See [FmodAudioBusLayout] for editing, saving, and the FMOD Audio Dock. Performance monitors are available in Godot's [b]Debugger > Monitors[/b] panel. [b]Performance Monitors:[/b] The following custom monitors are registered with Godot's Performance system: - [code]FmodCPUUsage/DSP[/code]: DSP processing CPU usage percentage - [code]FmodCPUUsage/Stream[/code]: Stream decoding CPU usage percentage - [code]FmodCPUUsage/Geometry[/code]: 3D geometry processing CPU usage percentage - [code]FmodCPUUsage/Update[/code]: System update CPU usage percentage - [code]FmodCPUUsage/Convolution1[/code]: Convolution reverb 1 CPU usage percentage - [code]FmodCPUUsage/Convolution2[/code]: Convolution reverb 2 CPU usage percentage - [code]FmodFileUsage/SampleBytesRead[/code]: Sample bytes read from disk - [code]FmodFileUsage/StreamBytesRead[/code]: Stream bytes read from disk - [code]FmodFileUsage/OtherBytesRead[/code]: Other bytes read from disk

method.name: get_main_system
method.description: Returns the main FMOD System instance. This is the primary interface for creating sounds, channels, DSP effects, and other FMOD objects. The system is automatically initialized during server startup with settings from ProjectSettings.

method.name: get_master_channel_group
method.description: Returns the master channel group that all sounds route through by default. This is the root of the channel group hierarchy and can be used to control global volume, pitch, and effects for all playing sounds.

method.name: get_audio_bus_layout
method.description: Returns the current configuration resource. In independent mode, edits are applied to bound runtime instances on the next server update, or immediately through [method flush_bus_updates]. In synchronization mode Godot AudioServer provides the configuration; edit it through the native Audio panel.

method.name: set_audio_bus_layout
method.description: Validates and builds [param layout] before replacing the current runtime graph. Playing channels move to matching bus names or Master. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_BUSY] in Godot synchronization mode, [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] for an invalid resource, or an initialization error. This does not save the resource or change the project default.

method.name: get_audio_bus
method.description: Returns the runtime bus named [param name], or [code]null[/code] when it does not exist. After adding a bus, call [method flush_bus_updates] before requesting it in the same frame. Direct runtime edits do not modify or save the layout configuration.

method.name: get_audio_bus_by_id
method.description: Returns the runtime bus with stable [param id], or [code]null[/code]. Bus IDs remain stable when the layout is reordered or a bus is renamed.

method.name: get_bus_effect_instance
method.description: Returns the live effect instance of [param slot_id] on [param bus_id], or [code]null[/code] if the bus or slot has no applied runtime instance. After adding a slot, call [method flush_bus_updates] before requesting it in the same frame. Use this instance for [FmodAudioEffectCapture] buffers, [FmodAudioEffectSpectrumAnalyzer] snapshots, and [FmodAudioEffectRecord] output. Each slot has its own instance, even when slots share a configuration resource. Runtime edits are not saved; subsequent configuration edits may update the instance.

method.name: get_bus_names
method.description: Returns bus names in the active FMOD layout display order. The three FmodAudioStreamPlayer node classes use this list for their Bus property.

method.name: is_syncing_godot_buses
method.description: Returns the startup value of [code]audio/fmod/sync_godot_audio_buses[/code]. Changing this project setting requires reloading the project.

method.name: flush_bus_updates
method.description: Applies pending configuration and effect parameter changes to the runtime graph immediately. The server normally does this once per frame. This call does not poll Godot AudioServer or save layout files.

method.name: create_layout_from_godot
method.description: Creates an independent configuration from the current Godot AudioServer buses and supported effects. Unsupported effects are skipped. This does not activate or save the result. The Dock conversion command also reports skipped effects.

method.name: generate_bus_layout
method.description: Refreshes the FMOD mirror from Godot AudioServer when synchronization is enabled. Does nothing in independent mode.

method.name: reset_main_system
method.description: Replaces the main system with [param system]. Configure and initialize the new system before calling this method. Releases the previous runtime instances and system, then rebuilds the active layout configuration on the new system. Objects from the previous system must not be reused.

signal.name: bus_layout_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the active layout is replaced or its bus names or display order change. Use it to refresh bus selectors.
